categories.title: Disaster
categories.shortDescription: Documented extreme environmental catastrophes, hydrological surges, seismic activity, and severe wildfire emergencies.

subcategories.name: Floods
subcategories.description: Monsoonal deluges, riverine overflows, flash floods, and glacial lake outburst floods (GLOF).

subcategories.name: Landslides
subcategories.description: Mass debris flows, slope failures, and hill collapses triggered by cloudbursts and seismic events.

subcategories.name: Cyclones
subcategories.description: Tropical storms, severe cyclonic systems, storm surges, and coastal wind damage.

subcategories.name: Earthquakes
subcategories.description: Tectonic ruptures, seismological faults, liquefaction, and structural geological damage.

subcategories.name: Tsunamis
subcategories.description: Undersea earthquake-generated ocean shockwaves, coastal inundation, and marine seismic surges.

subcategories.name: Forest Fires
subcategories.description: Wildfires, canopy blazes, dry-season biomass burning, and reserve forest ecological damage.

categories.title: Deforestation & Tree Plantation
categories.shortDescription: Historical canopy depletion, commercial clearance, grassroots afforestation drives, and award-winning conservationists.

subcategories.name: Deforestation Events
subcategories.description: Documented large-scale clearings for dams, mining projects, linear infrastructure, and illegal logging.

subcategories.name: Tree Plantation Campaigns
subcategories.description: Mass afforestation initiatives, state-led greening missions, and public sector canopy restoration drives.

subcategories.name: Forest Conservation Movements
subcategories.description: Grassroots indigenous and community resistance movements dedicated to safeguarding pristine woodlands.

subcategories.name: Award-Winning Environmental Work
subcategories.description: Recognized individual and organizational breakthroughs in afforestation, silviculture, and habitat revival.

categories.title: Pollution
categories.shortDescription: Toxic air shed episodes, aquatic contamination, hazardous industrial runoff, acoustic stress, and plastic crisis archives.

subcategories.name: Air Pollution
subcategories.description: Particulate matter surges (PM2.5 / PM10), stubble burning episodes, photochemical smogs, and industrial emissions.

subcategories.name: Water Pollution
subcategories.description: Untreated sewage dumping, riverine toxic froth, groundwater arsenic/fluoride crises, and aquatic dead zones.

subcategories.name: Noise Pollution
subcategories.description: Acoustic decibel violations from urban transit, festive sound amplification, and impacts on wildlife and public health.

subcategories.name: Plastic Pollution
subcategories.description: Single-use polymer accumulation, microplastic contamination, landfill fires, and marine coastal debris.

subcategories.name: Industrial Pollution
subcategories.description: Catastrophic toxic gas releases, chemical spills, heavy metal effluents, and factory perimeter contamination.

categories.title: Climate Change
categories.shortDescription: Thermal heat domes, Himalayan cryosphere retreat, coastal erosion from sea level rises, and extreme climatic anomalies.

subcategories.name: Heatwaves
subcategories.description: Severe atmospheric heat domes, wet-bulb temperature breaches, urban heat islands, and summer thermal mortality.

subcategories.name: Glacier Changes
subcategories.description: Himalayan and polar glacial recession, ablation rates, permafrost thaw, and moraine lake formation.

subcategories.name: Sea-Level Rise & Coastal Impacts
subcategories.description: Coastal island submersion, salt-water ingress into aquifers, mangrove retreat, and shoreline erosion.

subcategories.name: Extreme Weather Events
subcategories.description: Localized cloudbursts, unseasonal hailstorms, atmospheric rivers, and unprecedented seasonal shifts.

categories.title: Conservation & Success Stories
categories.shortDescription: Ecological restorations, river basin revivals, endangered species recoveries, and community-managed sanctuaries.

subcategories.name: River Restoration
subcategories.description: Desiltation, catchment afforestation, sewage interception, and ecological rejuvenation of historic river courses.

subcategories.name: Forest Restoration
subcategories.description: Native species reintroduction, degraded landscape rehabilitation, and biodiversity corridor establishment.

subcategories.name: Wildlife Conservation
subcategories.description: Keystone species revival (Tigers, Rhinos, Lions), anti-poaching operations, and community reserve models.

subcategories.name: Community Environmental Initiatives
subcategories.description: Sacred groves protection, community seed banks, traditional rain-harvesting (Johads/Kuhls), and village stewardship.
